name: Cascade Biotech Thermoregulation Hood
description:
A close-fitting hood with integrated thermoregulation circuits that maintain a stable temperature around the head and neck regardless of external conditions. The hood uses body-heat harvesting to power its micro-heating elements in cold environments and phase-change material packets to absorb excess heat in warm ones. No batteries required.

Designed for workers in extreme-temperature environments — foundry floors, refrigerated storage, exposed rooftops in summer. The hood's self-powering design means it works indefinitely without charging, making it valuable in off-grid situations.
functionality: Passive thermoregulation, no external power required, extreme temperature tolerance
what_it_says: Your work environment would cook or freeze an unprotected brain, and you handle it without thinking.
story_hooks: A maintenance worker wearing a Thermoregulation Hood survived an industrial accident that killed three unprotected coworkers — now the families want to know why only one person had the right gear.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, fitted hood that hugs the head and drapes down the neck and upper shoulders. The fabric has a subtle sheen from embedded circuit matrices. The design is minimalist and functional, with a streamlined silhouette that suggests advanced engineering. Visually reads as medical-grade or industrial-specialist gear.
physical_description.fit: Close-fitting and compression-like around the cranium and neck; extends down to mid-shoulder with gentle taper. Designed to maintain skin contact for optimal thermoregulation feedback. Not restrictive but intentionally snug.
physical_description.primary_material: Nano-weave synthetic composite blended with phase-change polymer packets. Core fabric is a treated ballistic-grade synth-wool hybrid with embedded copper-silver microcircuitry.
physical_description.texture: Smooth outer surface with subtle quilted micro-sections where phase-change material is distributed. Inner lining feels cool and slightly slick due to thermal-responsive coating. Fine metallic threads visible under close inspection.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal gray base with silver accent threading running along cervical ridge and temple zones. Faint iridescent oil-slick gradient visible when light hits the circuit-embedded sections.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap closure at the nape of neck; friction-fit design at the base means no fasteners needed once positioned. Self-adhering micro-grip edges prevent slippage.
distinctive_features: Integrated thermal-sensing nodes (small raised dots) distributed across crown and temples
Body-heat harvesting filament woven into inner surface — invisible but creates slight texture variation
Phase-change material pockets visible as subtle quilted diamond patterns
Cascade Biotech logo stamped in corner using thermochromic ink (only visible when hood is actively regulating)
Micro-vents near ear passages for acoustic clarity and moisture escape
Reinforced thermal-bridge break at base to prevent heat loss to torso
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover. Expensive enough to signal investment in worker safety, common enough in industrial sectors that Tier 3 foundry workers can access through corpo employment packages.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by foundry workers, hazmat specialists, deep-storage warehouse staff, and off-grid researchers. Signals either corpo-sponsored labor or self-sufficient independent operator. Associated with dangerous, temperature-extreme professions. Wearing one says: 'I work where conditions would kill the unprepared.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new (expensive enough to be maintained); develops slight discoloration over months from body salts and foundry particulate. Thermal nodes may show faint scoring from repeated activation. Phase-change pockets retain subtle creasing from repeated thermal cycling. Rarely patched — usually replaced when worn beyond function.

Close-up detail showing quilted phase-change material patterns and faint iridescent sheen. Moody industrial backdrop with red foundry light casting shadows; cool blue accent lighting highlights the hood's thermal nodes. Harsh rim lighting emphasizes the fabric's subtle metallic sheen.
